name: sbom-diff
description: Diffs the deployed image's SBOM against the release candidate's

docker.customCommand: sh -c 'wget -qO- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anchore/syft/main/install.sh | sh -s -- -b /tmp/bin v1.18.1 >/dev/null && /tmp/bin/syft -q -o cyclonedx-json=/tmp/base.json registry:$IMAGE_REPO:$DEPLOYED_TAG && /tmp/bin/syft -q -o cyclonedx-json=/tmp/head.json registry:$IMAGE_REPO:$CANDIDATE_TAG && sbom-diff /tmp/base.json /tmp/head.json --fail-on major --max-added-transitive 10'
